units.source_text: 医生在前面走，他们穿过走廊，进入一个房间。

en.t: The doctor walked ahead, and they passed through the corridor and entered a room.

units.source_text: 房间的一角，堆着一个有个装满酒精的大玻璃瓶，瓶子里浸着几副脑髓。

en.t: In one corner of the room stood a large glass jar filled with alcohol, and several brains were soaking inside it.

units.source_text: 在其中一副脑髓上，他发现上面隐约有一些发白的东西，似乎是撒上了一点蛋白。

en.t: On one of the brains, he noticed something faintly whitish on the surface, as if a little egg white had been sprinkled over it.

units.source_text: 他和医生站在一起交谈，又想起了自己的母亲。

en.t: As he stood talking with the doctor, he thought again of his own mother.
